questions.q: What was Amazon's original product focus?
questions.why: The book notes Amazon started by selling only books.

questions.q: How did Amazon handle publisher bans on public reviews?
questions.why: Amazon let people publicly review books despite publisher objections.

questions.q: What long‑term project does Bezos support to illustrate thinking decades ahead?
questions.why: Bezos backs a gigantic clock in Texas that will run for 10,000 years.

questions.q: What symbolic award does Amazon give for the best idea, even if it fails?
a: Just Do It award with a giant Nike shoe
questions.why: Amazon's "Just Do It" award includes an oversized Nike shoe.

questions.q: Why did Amazon adopt a DIY policy after the dot‑com bust?
a: To bring innovation in‑house after losing startup investments
questions.why: Losses from startup investments led Amazon to innovate internally.
